interface_debt.why: Every one of the 16 dependent repositories that includes cfe.h is forced to pull in the Executive Service API and, by the same pattern, all other cFE service APIs. Any evolution of cfe_es.h or any other included header—new function, changed prototype, new macro, removed declaration, or added include—changes the effective interface of cfe.h for all consumers, causing unnecessary recompiles, possible compilation failures from transitive-include dependencies, and coordinated changes when the cFE service set is reorganized.
interface_debt.better: Make each cFE service header self-contained and have applications include only the service headers they actually use; keep cfe.h minimal or eliminate the umbrella header rather than centralizing the entire cFE interface.
interface_debt.title: cFE:modules/core_api/fsw/inc/cfe.h: cfe.h — one header carries unrelated responsibilities

interface_debt.why: Callers must pass a pointer to a fixed-size array type and cannot pass a larger buffer or specify the buffer size. If cFE changes the status string length, format, or storage requirement, every repository that calls this function must change its buffer declaration and call site.
interface_debt.better: Use an explicit size parameter, such as CFE_Status_t CFE_ES_StatusToString(CFE_Status_t status, char *buf, size_t buf_size), or return the required length.
